notes.title: Major Ending Update + Sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you're doing well. I am very happy that Twilight Town has been received well and enjoyed by many!

I personally read every single review and I do agree that the game did end a bit too abruptly. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40037202/b76a025039115a79be0bbd384e5bd3ce74882681.jpg[/img]
So today I just pushed an update that EXTENDS the ending and ties up some loose ends! While it's by no means a sequel, I do hope this will satisfy those who wanted more out of the game in the meantime!

Oh and did I mention this game is on SALE? its the perfect time to buy it if you've been waiting or to gift it to a friend!

While you're at it, you can also check out my other games too, they're ALL on sale and if you liked Twilight Town, I guarantee you'll love these too!

My Inner Darkness Is A Hot Anime Girl!: 3D turn-based RPG game featuring surreal enemy designs and dream-like locations, packed into a gripping story about overcoming intrusive thoughts! (it even has a reference to twilight town somewhere!) ON SALE HERE:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1753050/My_Inner_Darkness_Is_A_Hot_Anime_Girl/

I Am The Prosecutor, No Evidence? No Problem!: A non-linear Visual Novel about defending a cute Tomboy named Sophie where you're given just 30 seconds to make the right choice each time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1591470/I_Am_The_Prosecutor_No_Evidence_No_Problem/

You can check out the rest of my games here: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/sigyaad

Thank you and have a wonderful day
